seo_title: Warrington's Only Official CrossFit Gym | CrossFit Warrington
seo_description: Warrington's only official CrossFit affiliate, based in Woolston. Coaching for every age and ability. Your first class is free.

hero.heading: Find your pace, your people, and a workout that adapts to you.

turn.heading: Where fitness feels like home.
turn.body: We believe training should be something you actually look forward to. Whether you're stepping into a gym for the first time or you've been training for years, all of our sociable group classes are built around one simple principle: helping you move better, get fitter, and keep showing up. Led by expert coaches who know how to get the best out of every person who walks through the door, there's a class here waiting for you.
turn.middle:
Our programmes are designed to suit all abilities and experience levels. Whether you're completely new to the gym, looking to improve your fitness, or training towards competitive goals, you'll have the coaching, programming and support to keep progressing.

But CrossFit Warrington is about more than just the workout.

Here, you'll train alongside people who want to see you succeed. You'll be encouraged, challenged and supported every step of the way. We work hard, celebrate each other's progress and, most importantly, have a lot of fun doing it.
turn.big: You don't need to be fit to start. You just need to start.
turn.big_line: We scale workouts, we don't change them. Whoever you are, whatever you do, you are capable of CrossFit.

join.heading: Join us.
join.intro: We believe fitness shouldn't be one-size-fits-all, and that starts from day one. Choose the path that best fits your confidence level and schedule:

tiles.title: One to One
tiles.label: New to CrossFit · 1-2-1 Foundations · 3 × 1-to-1 sessions
tiles.photo_description: A member training one to one with a coach at CrossFit Warrington
tiles.text: You'll work privately with a coach over three sessions to master the core movements at your own pace before joining our group classes.

tiles.title: Couch to CrossFit
tiles.label: New to CrossFit · Group Foundations · 6-week course
tiles.photo_description: A Couch to CrossFit group celebrating together at the end of a session
tiles.text: You'll progress alongside a supportive cohort of beginners, building your fitness, community, and confidence together week by week.

tiles.title: Become a member
tiles.label: Experienced
tiles.photo_description: Two CrossFit Warrington members smiling side by side
tiles.text:
**Find the membership that fits your life.**

Every membership includes top coaching, 25+ classes per week to choose from, and a community that makes showing up the easy part.

We offer a range of membership options depending on how often you would like to train.
tiles.price_line: Memberships start from as little as £65.92.

tiles.title: Kids
tiles.photo_description: Children high-fiving a coach at a CrossFit Kids class
tiles.text:
Our kids programme at CrossFit Warrington focuses on building physical literacy first. Without the pressure of heavy competition, we help kids move well, build body confidence, and genuinely enjoy being active.

With small class sizes and expert coaching, your child gets the personal attention they need to build healthy habits and learn to love movement for life.

**6-week terms throughout the year.**

tiles.title: Adaptive
tiles.photo_description: A coach supporting a member to walk during an Adaptive CrossFit session
tiles.text:
**Empowering individuals through movement.**

Fitness should be truly inclusive and accessible to everyone, regardless of ability. Our adaptive programme is built on the belief that everyone deserves the opportunity to train, grow, and challenge themselves in a supportive environment.

tiles.title: RACE Series
tiles.photo_description: Members carrying weights outside the gym during a RACE Series event
tiles.text:
Test your limits with our RACE Series (Resilience & Conditioning Events). Built around high-intensity functional fitness challenges, these year-round events are designed to break through mental and physical barriers and keep your momentum going.

**RACE as an individual, pair or team. Non-members welcome.**

tiles.title: Nutrition Coaching
tiles.photo_description: Two members laughing between exercises at CrossFit Warrington
tiles.text:
Training is only half the battle. To truly see and feel results, your nutrition needs to match your life. At CrossFit Warrington, we keep it simple and flexible:

**The 8-Week Group Reset:** Team up with the community for our seasonal challenges. Build real, sustainable habits together in a high-energy, supportive group environment.

**3-Month 1-to-1 Coaching:** Get deep, personalised guidance built around your exact body, schedule, and goals with a dedicated coach in your corner.

Whether you love the team accountability of a group reset or a completely custom 1-to-1 blueprint, we're here to help you thrive inside and outside the gym.

tiles.title: Personal Training
tiles.photo_description: A coach demonstrating a stretch to a member in a personal training session
tiles.text: Bespoke programmes built around your body, your goals and your lifestyle. Led by head coach Sian and our expert team, from athletic performance to post-injury recovery and neurological rehabilitation.

tiles.title: Online Coaching
tiles.photo_description: A member checking her form in the mirror during an online coaching session
tiles.text: Remote coaching delivers expert, bespoke training programmes directly to you, allowing you to achieve professional-level results on your own schedule and in your own space. Through continuous digital communication, video analysis, and data-driven adjustments, your coach ensures that every workout is tailored to push you toward your specific goals.

drop_in.heading: Drop in.
drop_in.text: In town for work or play? Keep your fitness on track. Experienced CrossFitters can drop into any class and immediately feel like part of the CrossFit Warrington family.
drop_in.button_note: Pick any class on the timetable.

community.photo_description: Members of the CrossFit Warrington community together in the gym
community.heading: No egos here.
community.text: Welcome to your new fitness home. CrossFit Warrington is a thriving community of everyday people lifting each other up through every tough workout and shared laugh. Whatever your age, background, or current fitness level, you belong here from day one. You don't need to get fit to join us—just take that first step.
